newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia 147-day t-bill tranche yields 33.86 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russia 147-day t-bill tranche yields 33.86 pct.

text.p: The annualised average yield on an issue of an additional 147-day tranche of series 22076 GKO discount Treasury bills was 33.86 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the Central Bank said.
The earlier tranche of the bills closed at 87.97 to yield 33.73 percent on Tuesday.
Dealers had forecast the annualised average yield for the new issue would be 32.96 to 33.57 percent.
Full details of the auction follow:

Earlier on Wednesday, the Finance Ministry raised 4.97 trillion roubles from an auction of 7.50 trillion roubles of 252-day Treasury bills, bringing total proceeds from Wednesday's auctions to 7.86 trillion roubles.
The Finance Ministry is also repaying 403.76 billion roubles in interest on the two year series 24008 OFZ interest-bearing government bond maturing in July 1998.
It is repaying 7.39 trillion roubles in the series 22049 T-bills which matures on Wednesday.
